::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 9th [1867]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell[^1]
:::

My dear [Mrs Johns](people/person_772.qmd),
I am very glad there is a prospect of our seeing [Miss Keary](people/person_793.qmd).  Would you or [Kate](people/person_887.qmd) be so kind as to let us know when she comes, and how long she is likely to be with you, and then we may fix a day for meeting or trying to meet.  Next week and the week after too we have friends coming to us just so invalidish that I dare not make engagements till I have seen how they are, and the length of the second visit also, but at any rate, I hope we shall not miss seeing you and Miss Keary

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Mrs Johns/ Winton House/ Winchester and postmarked Winchester 9 July 1867.
